Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

product — something made or sold. Example: This product is cheap.
food — what people eat. Example: The supermarket sells food and clothes.
clothes — the things you wear. Example: My favourite clothes are jeans.
medicine — something you take when you are ill. Example: You can buy medicine at the pharmacy.
book — pages with text you read. Example: The book costs ten euros.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Have you got any ...?
• Is it in stock?
• Sorry, we haven't got any.
• Yes, we have.
• It is in stock today.
